findings.reason: A zero seller is a caller mistake, not an exploit; the init access-control defect is scored separately.

findings.text: divide-before-multiply in `minNextBid` (line 58, CWE-682): EnglishAuction.minNextBid() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#58-63) performs a multiplication on the result of a division: - highestBid + highestBid / BPS * minIncrementBps (src/EnglishAuction.sol#62)

reentrancy-benign in `bid` (line 66, CWE-841): Reentrancy in EnglishAuction.bid() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#66-85): External calls: - (refunded,None) = highestBidder.call{value: highestBid}() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#75) State variables written after the call(s): - bidOf[msg.sender] = msg.value (src/EnglishAuction.sol#80) - earlyBidders.push(msg.sender) (src/EnglishAuction.sol#82)
findings.reason: Same refund-before-update ordering in bid(): bidOf and earlyBidders are written after the external call, so a re-entrant bid() sees stale state.

findings.text: reentrancy-eth in `bid` (line 66, CWE-841): Reentrancy in EnglishAuction.bid() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#66-85): External calls: - (refunded,None) = highestBidder.call{value: highestBid}() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#75) State variables written after the call(s): - highestBid = msg.value (src/EnglishAuction.sol#79) EnglishAuction.highestBid (src/EnglishAuction.sol#20) can be used in cross function reentrancies: - EnglishAuction.bid() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#66-85) - EnglishAuction.finalize() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#113-119) - EnglishAuction.highestBid (src/EnglishAuction.sol#20) - EnglishAuction.minNextBid() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#58-63) - highestBidder = msg.sender (src/EnglishAuction.sol#78) EnglishAuction.highestBidder (src/EnglishAuction.sol#19) can be used in cross function reentrancies: - EnglishAuction.bid() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#66-85) - EnglishAuction.highestBidder (src/EnglishAuction.sol#19)
findings.reason: The refund call to the previous highestBidder runs before highestBidder/highestBid are updated, so that bidder can re-enter bid() and be refunded twice; same issue as the audit's real bid() reentrancy finding.

findings.text: reentrancy-events in `bid` (line 66, CWE-841): Reentrancy in EnglishAuction.bid() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#66-85): External calls: - (refunded,None) = highestBidder.call{value: highestBid}() (src/EnglishAuction.sol#75) Event emitted after the call(s): - BidPlaced(msg.sender,msg.value) (src/EnglishAuction.sol#84)
findings.reason: Emitting BidPlaced after the refund call only reorders the event log; it is not a defect on its own.

findings.reason: bonusPaid is set before the call, so re-entry cannot draw again; a reentrant fundBonus only loses the winner's own top-up.
